-   **Strengths:** Enables interactive frame rates for large volumes that would otherwise be too slow for software rendering or too large for single-card hardware rendering [S1].

The claim states that the technique enables interactive frame rates for large volumes that would be too slow for software rendering or too large for single-card hardware rendering. The evidence explicitly supports both parts of this claim: 1) It mentions that limited video memory on consumer cards (single-card limitation) restricts volume size, which is mitigated by the cluster approach. 2) It states that the hardware-accelerated parallel approach enables interactive frame rates (2.0 fps) suitable for parameter tuning, whereas software methods are too slow for interactivity.
